THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE STORMS...CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND POSSIBLY A COUPLE OF TORNADOES...WILL BE ACROSS PORTIONS OF CENTRAL AND EASTERN KANSAS SOUTHWARD INTO NORTH-CENTRAL OKLAHOMA.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MULTIPLE MIDLEVEL SPEED MAXIMA WILL PROGRESS THROUGH BROADLY CYCLONIC FLOW ESTABLISHED ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE WRN/N-CNTRL CONUS. EMBEDDED WITHIN THIS FLOW...A COMPACT CYCLONE AND ATTENDANT SFC LOW PRESSURE WILL ADVANCE FROM PORTIONS OF THE NRN HIGH PLAINS TO THE SRN CANADIAN PRAIRIES. A FRONT WILL TRAIL SWD FROM THE SFC LOW TO PORTIONS OF THE CNTRL GREAT PLAINS. A DRYLINE IS FORECAST TO INTERSECT THE FRONT OVER CNTRL KS AROUND PEAK HEATING...AND EXTEND SSWWD INTO PARTS OF SWRN TX. E OF THE FRONT/DRYLINE...A PERSISTENT LLJ WILL FACILITATE POLEWARD TRANSPORT OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE OVER THE GREAT PLAINS THROUGH THE PERIOD...WHILE A MIDLEVEL SPEED MAX PROGRESSES FROM THE CNTRL/SRN ROCKIES TO THE CNTRL CONUS.

sections.title: PORTIONS OF THE CNTRL/SRN GREAT PLAINS TO WRN MN
sections.text: DIURNALLY STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES NEAR/E OF THE FRONT/DRYLINE WILL LIKELY FACILITATE DESTABILIZATION THROUGH PEAK HEATING -- ESPECIALLY FROM PORTIONS OF CNTRL/ERN KS SWD INTO CNTRL/WRN OK. THIS WOULD OCCUR IN THE WAKE OF ELEVATED CONVECTION AND RELATED CLOUD DEBRIS MAINTAINED THROUGH THE MORNING BY ISENTROPIC ASCENT ALONG THE LLJ. PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT MID-AFTERNOON TSTM DEVELOPMENT SHOULD FAVOR THE FRONTAL ZONE ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL KS SWD ALONG THE DRYLINE INTO N-CNTRL OK. FROM PARTS OF CNTRL/ERN KS TO N-CNTRL OK...SFC DEWPOINTS ARE FORECAST TO CLIMB INTO THE LOWER/MIDDLE 60S E OF THE FRONT/DRYLINE. THIS WILL SUPPORT MLCAPE ON THE ORDER OF 1000-2000 J/KG. GIVEN A VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILE SUPPORTING 35-45 KT OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR...THESE FACTORS MAY INITIALLY SUPPORT ISOLATED TO SCATTERED SUPERCELL STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL -- SOME POSSIBLY SIGNIFICANT. THE INFLUX OF AT LEAST PARTIALLY MODIFIED LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE...COMBINED WITH AN EARLY-EVENING UPTICK IN EFFECTIVE SRH /INCREASING TO AROUND 150-250 M2 PER S2/...SUGGESTS THAT SOME TORNADO POTENTIAL MAY EXIST PRIOR TO MORE SUBSTANTIAL DECOUPLING OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER. HOWEVER...THE STRONGEST LOW-LEVEL MASS

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN GREAT PLAINS NORTHWARD INTO PARTS OF THE FAR EASTERN DAKOTAS AND WESTERN MINNESOTA. THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE STORMS...CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES...WILL BE ACROSS PORTIONS OF CENTRAL AND EASTERN KANSAS AND NORTH-CENTRAL OKLAHOMA.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: RELATED TO AN EAST/NORTHEASTWARD-SHIFTING UPPER TROUGH...STRENGTHENING/CYCLONICALLY CURVED MID/HIGH-LEVEL FLOW WILL CONTINUE TO OVERSPREAD THE PLAINS TOWARD THE UPPER MIDWEST/LOWER MO VALLEY THROUGH TONIGHT. A TROUGH-EMBEDDED UPPER LOW WILL PIVOT OVER THE NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS...WHILE A SHORTWAVE TROUGH/SPEED MAX OVERSPREADS AN INCREASINGLY MOIST/UNSTABLE BOUNDARY LAYER LATER TODAY ACROSS THE SOUTH-CENTRAL PLAINS/MIDDLE MO VALLEY.

sections.title: SOUTH-CENTRAL PLAINS INCLUDING KS/OK
sections.text: CONSIDERABLE CLOUD COVER/SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE PRESENT EARLY THIS MORNING FROM EAST-CENTRAL NEB SOUTHWARD INTO NORTH-CENTRAL/WEST-CENTRAL OK. WHILE A FEW STRONGER STORMS WILL PERSIST...ORGANIZED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE UNLIKELY EARLY TODAY. IN THE WAKE OF THIS ACTIVITY...A MODERATELY MOIST AIR MASS FOR THE SEASON WILL BE TRANSPORTED NORTHWARD...WITH MOSTLY LOWER/MIDDLE 60S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS /WHICH ARE AS FAR NORTH AS NORTH-CENTRAL TX AS OF 12Z/ BECOMING INCREASINGLY ESTABLISHED ACROSS OK INTO CENTRAL/EASTERN KS. A 13.5 G/KG MEAN-MIXING RATIO WAS NOTED IN THE 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDING FROM FORT WORTH THIS MORNING /ROUGHLY 90TH PERCENTILE CLIMATOLOGICALLY/. GIVEN ANTICIPATED DIURNAL HEATING/MIXING ON THE WESTERN PERIPHERY OF THE EARLY-DAY DEPARTING CLOUDS/PRECIPITATION...THIS SHOULD RESULT IN UPWARDS OF 1000-2000 J/KG MLCAPE BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON AHEAD OF THE EAST/SOUTHEAST-MOVING COLD FRONT ACROSS KS AND NEAR/EAST OF THE DRYLINE ACROSS OK. AIDED BY INCREASING FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THE EAST/NORTHEASTWARD-EJECTING BASED-EMBEDDED SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED SPEED MAX ALOFT...THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD INITIALLY DEVELOP AS EARLY AS 20Z-21Z ACROSS CENTRAL KS NEAR THE FRON

sections.title: MIDDLE MO VALLEY TO FAR EASTERN DAKOTAS/WESTERN MN
sections.text: PRE-COLD FRONTAL MOISTURE/BUOYANCY WILL BE MORE LIMITED ACROSS THE REGION...PARTICULARLY GIVEN THE POTENTIAL FOR MORE WIDESPREAD CLOUD COVER AND LINGERING PRECIPITATION. EVEN SO...IN THE PRESENCE OF AMPLE FORCING FOR ASCENT AND STRENGTHENING DEEP-LAYER SHEAR MAY SUPPORT SOME LOW-TOPPED/EMBEDDED ROTATING STORMS AND SMALL QUASI-LINEAR SEGMENTS CAPABLE OF ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL/WIND THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. ..GUYER/COOK.. 10/04/2016

sections.title: NORTHERN OK INTO EASTERN KS/NEB/IA/MO
sections.text: A LARGE UPPER TROUGH CONTINUES TO PUSH EASTWARD ACROSS THE ROCKIES AND INTO THE PLAINS STATES TODAY. WATER VAPOR LOOPS SHOWS A RATHER STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH ROUNDING THE BASE OF THE TROUGH OVER CO...WHICH IS EXPECTED TO EJECT INTO PARTS OF KS/NEB LATER TODAY. STRONG SOUTHERLY WINDS AHEAD OF THIS SYSTEM WILL HELP TO RAPIDLY TRANSPORT MID 60S DEWPOINTS NORTHWARD INTO EASTERN KS...RESULTING IN AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES OF AROUND 1500 J/KG AND ONLY MINIMAL CAP. STRONG FORCING IS EXPECTED TO RESULT IN SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG A COLD FRONT MOVING ACROSS THE AREA. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW SUBSTANTIAL LOW LEVEL SHEAR/HELICITY AND RELATIVELY STEEP LAPSE RATES...SUGGESTING THE POSSIBILITY OF SEVERAL HAIL-PRODUCING SUPERCELLS. A TORNADO THREAT IS ALSO APPARENT IN THIS REGION...BUT THE SMALL 10 PERCENT RISK AREA SUGGESTS GREATER CONFIDENCE/PRECISION THAN IS PROBABLY WARRANTED. NEVERTHELESS WILL MAINTAIN THIS AREA TO DENOTE THE RISK OF AN ISOLATED BUT IMPORTANT TORNADIC STORM SOMEWHERE OVER SOUTHERN KS OR NORTHERN OK. ACTIVITY WILL SPREAD NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE ENH/SLGT RISK AREAS THROUGH THE EVENING WITH AN EVENTUAL EVOLUTION TO MORE LINEAR STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS

sections.title: CENTRAL/SOUTHERN OK
sections.text: THE MAJORITY OF 12Z CAM SOLUTIONS SHOW THE POTENTIAL FOR AN ISOLATED INTENSE STORM OR TWO OVER PARTS OF CENTRAL/SOUTHERN OK LATE THIS AFTERNOON OR EARLY EVENING. WHILE THERE ARE NO OBVIOUS FORCING MECHANISMS APPARENT IN SATELLITE IMAGERY...THIS MAY BE ASSOCIATED WITH THE LINGERING MID-LEVEL CONVECTION OVER CENTRAL OK AND EVENTUAL INTENSIFICATION NEAR THE DRYLINE WHERE CIRCULATIONS ARE DEEPEST. REGARDLESS...FORECAST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST A THREAT OF SUPERCELLS PRODUCING VERY LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS TORNADOES ACROSS THE REGION IF DEVELOPMENT OCCURS. HAVE THEREFORE EXTENDED THE SLIGHT RISK SOUTHWARD TO INCLUDE THIS RISK. ..HART/PICCA.. 10/04/2016

sections.title: OK INTO KS AND ERN NEB
sections.text: SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS CU DEEPENING ALONG A COLD FRONT FROM SRN NEB INTO CNTRL KS. AHEAD OF THIS FRONT...AREAS OF HEATING WERE CONTRIBUTING TO DESTABILIZATION. MIDDAY SPECIAL SOUNDINGS FROM THE REGION SHOW MLCAPE VALUES AROUND 1000-1500 J/KG IMMEDIATELY AHEAD OF THE FRONT AND SWD ALONG THE DRYLINE WHERE CONVERGENCE WAS WEAKER. SFC OBSERVATIONS ALSO SHOW RELATIVELY STRONG FLOW OVER THE WARM SECTOR...AND THIS MAY BE COUNTERACTING DEWPOINT ADVECTION WITH VERTICAL MIXING. THIS MIXING AND HIGH SFC WIND SPEEDS WILL ALSO HAVE A TENDENCY TO REDUCE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR...HOWEVER...SHEAR REMAINS QUITE STRONG NEAR THE WARM FRONT ALONG THE MO RIVER WITH TOP SOUNDING SHOWING 0-3 KM SRH IN EXCESS OF 400 M2/S2. ROTATION COULD BE ENHANCED WITH ANY STORMS THAT FORM AND SHIFT INTO THIS SRH RICH AREA. STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM LATER THIS AFTERNOON ALONG THE COLD FRONT IN KS...AND ACROSS PARTS OF SW OK WHERE HEATING IS STRONG AND DEWPOINTS ELEVATED. HAIL WILL BE A LIKELY THREAT IN ALL AREAS...WITH A FEW VERY LARGE STONES WITH ANY SUPERCELLS. GIVEN A SOMEWHAT LINEAR FORCING MECHANISM IN KS...STORMS MAY HAVE A TENDENCY TO MERGE WITH TIME...BUT EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS ARE POSSIBLE ALONG

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD GRADUALLY INCREASE IN COVERAGE ACROSS CENTRAL KANSAS AND SOUTH-CENTRAL NEBRASKA LATER THIS AFTERNOON...BEFORE SPREADING EAST THIS EVENING. THE PRIMARY THREATS WILL LIKELY BE LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS...BUT A COUPLE TORNADOES MAY BE POSSIBLE AS WELL...GENERALLY PRIOR TO SUNSET. WATCH ISSUANCE IS LIKELY WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WATER-VAPOR IMAGERY CLEARLY DEPICTS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH PUSHING INTO WESTERN KS THIS AFTERNOON. AS THIS IMPULSE REACHES CENTRAL KANSAS...SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ALONG A SURFACE TROUGH WEST OF THE I-35/135 CORRIDOR...AS WELL AS FARTHER NORTH INTO SOUTH-CENTRAL NEBRASKA. IN COMBINATION WITH IMPROVING BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE...SFC HEATING BEHIND EARLIER CONVECTION IS SUPPORTING MLCAPE VALUES UPWARDS OF 1000-1500 J/KG...AND POCKETS UPWARDS OF 2000 J/KG MAY MATERIALIZE BY LATE AFTERNOON. IN ADDITION TO MODEST DIRECTIONAL SHEAR...VIGOROUS MID-LEVEL SOUTH/SOUTHWESTERLIES AROUND 45-55 KTS ARE SUPPORTING AMPLE DEEP SHEAR FOR UPDRAFT ORGANIZATION/ROTATION TODAY. AS SUCH...WHILE INSTABILITY IS NOT PARTICULARLY ROBUST...FAIRLY EFFICIENT HAIL GROWTH SHOULD LEAD TO SEVERAL LARGE-HAIL REPORTS. ADDITIONALLY...SUFFICIENT LOW-LEVEL SHEAR AND INITIALLY DISCRETE SUPERCELLULAR DEVELOPMENT MAY ENCOURAGE A COUPLE OF TORNADOES DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON AND EARLY EVENING HOURS. THEREAFTER...STORM SPLITS/DOWNSTREAM ANVIL SEEDING FROM A RELATIVELY UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILE WILL LIKELY FAVOR UPSCALE GROWTH...LOWERING THE TORNADO THREAT AND ENHANCING THE WIND THREAT WITH EASTWARD EXTENT. REGARDLESS...CONSIDERING THE INCREASING THREAT FOR ALL SEVERE MODES THIS AFTERNOON...WATCH ISSUANCE IS LIKELY WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SHORT TERM MODELS CONTINUE TO SUGGEST A FEW STORMS WILL DEVELOP NEAR LAWTON/FORT SILL TO CHICKASHA BY LATE THIS AFTERNOON WITH STORMS SPREADING INTO THE OKLAHOMA CITY METRO AREA BY EARLY EVENING. VERY LARGE HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS...THOUGH A TORNADO OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY AFTERNOON VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWED CU FORMING IN VICINITY OF A DRYLINE WHICH EXTENDED FROM SOUTH-CENTRAL KS THROUGH WESTERN OK TO WESTERN NORTH TX...WHILE THE BOUNDARY LAYER HAS CONTINUED TO MOISTEN TODAY GIVEN PERSISTENT SOUTHERLY LOW-LEVEL WINDS. SURFACE TEMPERATURES RISING INTO THE LOWER-MID 80S ARE AIDING IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF MODERATE INSTABILITY EAST OF THE DRY LINE. THE DEVELOPMENT OF TOWERING CU WAS OBSERVED IN SOUTHWEST OK /SOUTH OF ALTUS/...AND THIS MAY BE ATTENDANT TO STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT MOVING INTO OK AND THE RED RIVER VALLEY AS STRONGER WESTERLY MIDLEVEL WINDS SPREAD TOWARD THE DISCUSSION AREA. RECENT FREDERICK RADAR INDICATED AN INCREASE IN SOUTHWESTERLY 700-MB WINDS TO 40-45 KT...WHILE THE OUN 19Z SPECIAL SOUNDING SHOWED A VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILE WITH SFC-1 KM SRH EXCEEDING 200 M2/S2 AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 35-40 KT. ADDITIONAL SURFACE HEATING WILL RESULT IN FURTHER DESTABILIZATION /MLCAPE 1500-2000 J PER KG/ THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS OK. STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL TEND TO GLANCE OK AS GREATER LIFT SPREADS INTO KS/NEB. THIS SHOULD LEAD TO LOWER STORM COVERAGE...THOUGH A MORE FAVORABLE CAPE/SHEAR PARAMETER SPACE CONTINUES TO SUPPORT SUPERCELL FORMATION AS DEEP-LAYER SHEAR VECTORS ARE ORIENTED MORE NORMAL TO THE DRY LINE. LATEST RUNS OF THE HRRR MAINTAIN STORM DEVELOPMENT IN SOUTHWEST TO SOUTH-CENTRAL OK /BETWEEN LAW/FSI AND CHK/ BY 22Z...WITH ACTIVITY SPREADING TOWARD THE OKC METRO AREA BY EARLY THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR SVR TSTMS INCLUDING TORNADOES CONTINUES ACROSS WW 490.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE SVR RISK INTO THE LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING HOURS WILL VARY WITHIN MULTIPLE REGIMES: /1/ DISCRETE/SEMI-DISCRETE CELLS NOW DEVELOPING W/SW OF WICHITA ALONG A DRYLINE WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO BECOME ROOTED AT THE SFC. THE AIR MASS E OF THIS ACTIVITY IS CHARACTERIZED BY MLCAPE AROUND 1500-2000 J/KG AND EFFECTIVE SHEAR AROUND 45 KT. THIS ACTIVITY WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL OF PRODUCING VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND WHILE SPREADING ACROSS PARTS OF S-CNTRL KS. TORNADOES MAY OCCUR AS INCIPIENT STAGES OF NOCTURNAL BOUNDARY-LAYER DECOUPLING FOSTER AN UPTICK IN LOW-LEVEL SRH. /2/ QUASI-LINEAR-MODE CONVECTION CONTINUES DEVELOPING ALONG A FRONT ARCING FROM S-CNTRL NEB TO CNTRL KS. THIS ACTIVITY IS ORIENTED MORE PARALLEL TO THE MIDLEVEL FLOW...AND WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING SVR WINDS AND POSSIBLY SVR HAIL WHILE SPREADING NEWD. /3/ SOMEWHAT MORE SEMI-DISCRETE/CLUSTER-MODE CONVECTION -- INCLUDING SUPERCELL STRUCTURES -- IS EVOLVING WITHIN A PLUME OF WAA ACROSS NERN KS. ALL SVR HAZARDS COULD ACCOMPANY THIS ACTIVITY AS IT SPREADS ACROSS NERN KS AND INTO SERN NEB SHORTLY. THE TWX VWP INDICATES AMPLE LOW-LEVEL SRH...CAPABLE OF SUPPORTING A BRIEF TORNADO WITH ANY SUSTAINED RIGHT-MOVING SUPERCELLS. HOWEVER...MUTED DIURNAL GAINS IN LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES OWING TO WIDESPREAD CLOUDS/PRECIP COULD BE A LIMITING FACTOR FOR GREATER TORNADO POTENTIAL. ..COHEN.. 10/04/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS DEVELOPING INVOF DRYLINE OVER NWRN OK MAY INTENSIFY WITH SUPERCELLS POSSIBLE...AS THEY MOVE EWD INTO FAVORABLE PARAMETER SPACE OVER NRN OK IN BETWEEN WWS 490-491...WHILE ACTIVITY NEAR KS BORDER MOVES INTO SRN PORTIONS WW 491. WW EXTENSION...OR LESS LIKELY A NEW WW...MAY BE REQUIRED FOR N-CENTRAL OK.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VIS IMAGERY SHOWS INCREASING DEPTH AND COVERAGE OF DEEP CONVECTIVE TOWERS MOVING OFF DRYLINE...ACROSS PORTIONS DEWEY/MAJOR/WOODS COUNTIES AND NNEWD OVER KS. AIR MASS AHEAD OF THIS ACTIVITY IS FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT WITH ANY SUSTAINED AND RELATIVELY DISCRETE TSTMS. NARROW/100-NM-WIDE CORRIDOR OF 60S F SFC DEW POINTS...ASSOCIATED 1.25-1.5-INCH PW AND 14-15 G/KG MEAN MIXING RATIOS WILL PERSIST AMIDST LATE-AFTN SFC HEATING TO SUPPORT MLCAPE 1500-2000 J/KG AND 0-3-KM CAPE 100-200 J/KG. VWP DATA AND MODIFIED MODEL SOUNDINGS EACH SUGGEST 40-50-KT WSWLY EFFECTIVE-SHEAR VECTORS -- ORIENTED WITH GREATER COMPONENT ACROSS THAN PARALLEL TO DRYLINE. THIS SUPPORTS POTENTIAL FOR BKN LINEAR TO DISCRETE MODES. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING GUSTS EACH ARE POSSIBLE. EVENING LLJ ENHANCEMENT TO 2-3-KM AGL WINDS SHOULD ENLARGE HODOGRAPHS IN SUPPORT OF TORNADO POTENTIAL WITH ANY SUSTAINED/DISCRETE SUPERCELL STILL ACTIVE...UNTIL GRADUAL SFC DIABATIC COOLING ADVERSELY INCREASES STATIC STABILITY IN NEAR-SFC LAYER LATE THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A LOW-POTENTIAL/ISOLATED SVR RISK MAY OCCUR WITH TSTMS SPREADING NEWD ACROSS PARTS OF THE MID-MO VALLEY THROUGH THE EVENING. WHILE CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED...WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WATER VAPOR LOOPS IMPLY A COMPACT MIDLEVEL PERTURBATION APPROACHING THE MID-MO VALLEY. PRECEDING STRONG DEEP ASCENT HAS ENCOURAGED THE RECENT UPTICK IN CONVECTIVE ACTIVITY FROM PARTS OF E-CNTRL TO NERN NEB. THIS ACTIVITY WILL SPREAD NEWD THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. STRONG LOW-LEVEL AND DEEP SHEAR MAY SUPPORT ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE STRUCTURES. HOWEVER...GIVEN THE COOL/MODESTLY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER -- AND LITTLE OPPORTUNITY FOR APPRECIABLE POSITIVE THETA-E ADVECTION NEAR THE SFC -- BUOYANCY IS QUITE LIMITED AS LOW-LEVEL STATIC STABILITY IS CONSIDERABLE. AS SUCH...ANY TORNADO/DMGG-WIND POTENTIAL WILL BE MINIMAL...AND THE CLUSTER/QUASI-LINEAR MODES SHOULD LIMIT THE SVR-HAIL RISK. NEVERTHELESS...A FEW EMBEDDED ROTATING CONVECTIVE ELEMENTS MAY OCCUR...AND AN ISOLATED SVR TSTM CANNOT ENTIRELY BE RULED OUT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR-TSTM/TORNADO RISK CONTINUES IN WW 490.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR LOOPS SUGGEST SEMI-DISCRETE SUPERCELLS BECOMING ESTABLISHED FROM THE WICHITA AREA SWD INTO FAR NRN OK. THIS ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY TRACK ENEWD DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. SVR HAIL/WIND MAY OCCUR. THE ICT VWP INDICATES AROUND 200 M2/S2 OF 0-1-KM SRH...AND FURTHER GAINS IN LOW-LEVEL SRH MAY OCCUR WITH NOCTURNAL DECOUPLING OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER...PRIOR TO SUBSTANTIAL INCREASES IN MLCINH. A TORNADO COULD OCCUR WITH THE MOST DISCRETE/SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS. MORE QUASI-LINEAR MODES ACCOMPANY ONGOING CONVECTION FARTHER N FROM NERN KS INTO SERN NEB...AND THIS ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE SPREADING EWD/NEWD. DMGG WINDS...SVR HAIL...AND POSSIBLY A BRIEF TORNADO COULD ACCOMPANY THIS ACTIVITY EVOLVING AMIDST STRONG LOW-LEVEL/DEEP SHEAR. ..COHEN.. 10/04/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: FULL-SPECTRUM SVR POTENTIAL CONTINUES ACROSS WW AREA... THOUGH COVERAGE SHOULD BE ISOLATED AND MUCH OF WW MAY NOT BE AFFECTED. WW EXPIRES AT 02Z...AND NEW WW MAY BE REQUIRED PRIOR TO THAT TIME TO COVER ANY CONTINUING SVR POTENTIAL INTO LATE EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ENVIRONMENT WILL REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS THROUGH AT LEAST 02Z WITH ANY SUSTAINED/DISCRETE CONVECTION OVER WW AREA. TWO PRIMARY TSTMS ARE EVIDENT ATTM...EACH WITH SUPERCELLULAR STRUCTURES BASED ON COMBINATION OF RADAR IMAGERY AND VISUAL CHARACTERISTICS ASCERTAINED FROM CHASE-VIDEO FEEDS. LIKELY SVR CELL OVER GRANT COUNTY SHOULD MOVE MORE RIGHTWARD AND OBLIQUELY/GRADUALLY CROSS KS/OK BORDER FROM NRN KAY COUNTY DURING NEXT COUPLE HOURS... PERHAPS CLIPPING NWRN OSAGE COUNTY...BEFORE IT MOVES INTO MORE STABLE AIR AND WEAKENS. MEANWHILE...LOW-PRECIP SUPERCELL OVER PORTIONS GRADY/CADDO COUNTIES PROJECTS ENEWD TOWARD PORTIONS OKC METRO. THIS CELL HAS A MORE-UNCERTAIN FUTURE GIVEN ITS SMALL UPDRAFT SIZE AND STG TILT WITH HEIGHT.
